title: A and An
introduction: Practise a and an with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: Use a or an before a single countable thing when it is not already identified. Choose by the next sound.
rules: Use a before a consonant sound and an before a vowel sound.
Listen to the first sound, not just the first written letter.
For one countable thing: a mango, an egg. Do not normally use a or an before plural nouns.
Use a before a consonant sound: a book.
Use an before a vowel sound: an apple.

grammar.description: a ruler, a kitten, a uniform
an umbrella, an insect, an hour

examples.question: Choose an article for orange.
steps: Orange begins with a vowel sound.

examples.question: Choose an article for bicycle.
steps: Bicycle begins with a consonant sound.

examples.question: Choose an article for hour.
steps: The h is silent in hour.

examples.question: Choose an article for insect.
steps: Insect begins with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ elephant
exercises.solution: Elephant begins with a vowel sound, so use an.

exercises.question: ___ mango
exercises.solution: Mango begins with the consonant sound /m/.

exercises.question: ___ umbrella
exercises.solution: Umbrella begins with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ ruler
exercises.solution: Ruler begins with the consonant sound /r/.

exercises.question: ___ octopus
exercises.solution: Octopus begins with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ pencil case
exercises.solution: Pencil begins with the consonant sound /p/.

exercises.question: ___ ant
exercises.solution: Ant begins with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ flower
exercises.solution: Flower begins with the consonant sound /f/.

exercises.question: ___ ice cream (one serving)
exercises.solution: Ice begins with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ uniform
exercises.solution: Uniform starts with the consonant sound /j/, like the y in yes.

exercises.question: ___ hour
exercises.solution: The h in hour is silent, so the word starts with a vowel sound.

exercises.question: ___ book
exercises.solution: Book begins with the consonant sound /b/.

summary: Use a or an before a single countable thing when it is not already identified. Choose by the next sound.
